title: Change or determination of IMS voice availability

entities.name: Change or determination of IMS voice availability
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE in single-registration mode when IMS voice availability is determined or changes. Governs how UE disables N1 mode capability based on IMS voice availability conditions and UE registration status.

entities.name: IMS voice not available over 3GPP access only with voice centric usage
entities.description: Condition where IMS voice is not available only over 3GPP access and UE's usage setting is voice centric.

entities.name: IMS voice not available over non-3GPP access only with voice centric usage
entities.description: Condition where IMS voice is not available only over non-3GPP access and UE's usage setting is voice centric.

entities.name: IMS voice not available over both accesses with voice centric usage
entities.description: Condition where IMS voice is not available over both 3GPP and non-3GPP access and UE's usage setting is voice centric.

entities.name: Disable N1 mode capability for 3GPP access
entities.description: Procedure to disable N1 mode capability specifically for 3GPP access, referenced from subclause 4.9.2.

entities.name: Disable N1 mode capability for non-3GPP access
entities.description: Procedure to disable N1 mode capability specifically for non-3GPP access, referenced from subclause 4.9.3.

entities.name: UE only registered over 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where UE is registered only over 3GPP access network.

entities.name: UE only registered over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where UE is registered only over non-3GPP access network.

entities.name: UE registered over both 3GPP and non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where UE is registered over both 3GPP and non-3GPP access networks.

entities.name: Voice centric usage setting
entities.description: UE configuration property indicating voice-centric usage preference.

relations.description: IMS voice availability change procedure is triggered when IMS voice is not available over 3GPP access only with voice centric usage.
IMS voice availability change procedure is triggered when IMS voice is not available over non-3GPP access only with voice centric usage.
IMS voice availability change procedure is triggered when IMS voice is not available over both accesses with voice centric usage.
Condition of IMS voice not available over 3GPP access only establishes the procedure to disable N1 mode for 3GPP access.
Condition of IMS voice not available over non-3GPP access only establishes the procedure to disable N1 mode for non-3GPP access.
Condition of IMS voice not available over both accesses establishes the procedure to disable N1 mode for 3GPP access.
Condition of IMS voice not available over both accesses establishes the procedure to disable N1 mode for non-3GPP access.
Disabling N1 mode for 3GPP access requires that UE is only registered over 3GPP access.
Disabling N1 mode for non-3GPP access requires that UE is only registered over non-3GPP access.
Disabling N1 mode for 3GPP access when registered over both accesses requires UE registration over both 3GPP and non-3GPP.
Disabling N1 mode for non-3GPP access when registered over both accesses requires UE registration over both 3GPP and non-3GPP.
IMS voice not available condition over 3GPP access is guarded by voice centric usage setting.
IMS voice not available condition over non-3GPP access is guarded by voice centric usage setting.
IMS voice not available condition over both accesses is guarded by voice centric usage setting.
